items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Eubie Blake only in the context of a story told by the interviewer about someone else ('he shocked everybody when he brought out... Eubie Blake'). The interviewee does not claim a personal relationship.

ctx.x: Some of them I've been on actually it's so -- they're so haphazard. Nobody ever doesn't seem to know what they're doing, when they're doing it or what. But this thing you know exactly what you're doing. Now, he might improvise and switch which is good, and switch things around a little bit. Sometimes he might say, oh, I think I'll put on four trombones and a rhythm section right here this time, and it works. He does it, you know. Say let's play a few numbers, two or three songs together before we bring the next…
And he shocked everybody when he brought out Faddis and -- Jon Faddis. Can you imagine that? And Eubie Blake. 22 and 94. He should name that number 2294.
